title: A Hollow for the Salt
author: Vesper Kavanagh
blurb: Sebastian Okonkwo, an exiled storm-caller, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
